messages.subject: Error when creating coverage layer
parts:
Dear list,

I am trying to design a new survey in Distance6 and importing the shapefile of the survey area worked but when I try to create a coverage layer with the Study Area as parent layer the following error appears:





In the properties for the coverage layer I used Transverse Mercator for projection and 100 metres but it also does not work if I use other settings.

I would be very grateful if someone could help me solve this problem. 


Best wishes


Jasmin Grammes

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Error when creating coverage layer
parts:
Afraid it could be any number of things Jasmin.

Before trying to put a coverage layer onto your study area, did you try to map the study area layer?  This would help diagnose problems that may exist with the study area shape file.  Is the infamous "LinkID" present in the imported shape file? Have a look at the section on "Importing Existing GIS Data | Prepare the Shapefile" in Chapter 5 of the Users Guide.  That is on page 62 of the users guide that ships with Distance 6.2 release 1.  This describes the creation of this mandatory field.

The coverage grid is looking at your study area shape file to determine the area onto which to drop a mesh of points presumably for your prediction grid layer.

messages.author: 39f0839e8d6a4470
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error when creating coverage layer
parts:
Hello Jasmin,

Overflow to me sound like Distance is perhaps trying to create too many points in the coverage grid.

I would remove any attempts to transform the shapefile within Distance for now. (I actually always handle any transformation outside Distance before importing the shapefile and then just work with them in m or km within Distance. Doing transformations in Distance can slow things down.)

Have a look at the survey region within the map browser and see what a fairly large spacing might be (you will see the coordinates changing at the bottom as the mouse moves across the screen) and use this value to create the coverage grid.

If you are still having problems please send me the project and I will take a look.

None of this functionality was updated in Distance 7 so I don't think this version will offer you an easy fix.

Laura


 
Dr. L. Marshall

University of St. Andrews
